component.name: HugMesh Image Studio
component.summary: Build HugMesh images and run a mesh from your tray

description.p: HugMesh Image Studio is a desktop wizard for the HugMesh platform. It builds hardened OS images for every cluster role without needing to remember builder script flags, and it runs a local mesh from the system tray.

ul.li: A guided wizard over every generator flag — role, platform, GPU driver, branding, encryption, optional services.
A hardware scanner that pre-fills the build from the machine you are on.
A system-tray controller that starts, stops and inspects a local mesh node and the full local stack.
Resource limits: cap the CPU, memory and GPU that builds, the local stack and emulated meshes may use, so the machine stays usable.
Device imaging: write a finished image to an attached USB, SD or eMMC device.
Building images requires Docker on the host, or a Gentoo host for a native build. The Studio drives those tools; it does not replace them.
Point the Studio at a hugmesh-generator checkout on first run. It reads the build scripts and cluster specs from there, so it cannot work without one.

Flashing a device and running an emulated mesh need host access to block devices and QEMU. Inside a Flatpak sandbox these need the host filesystem permission this package requests, and they will report what is missing rather than failing silently.

description.p: Studio 0.3.0-beta.2. See the GitHub release notes for what changed.

ul.li: Windows MSI and Linux Flatpak installers.
Resource limits for CPU, memory and GPU across the build, local-stack and emulation lanes.
